correctness.rationale: The positive support is a vertex cover exactly when the zero set is independent. In a complete multipartite graph this confines all zeros to one part. For a zero in \(X_i\), the neighborhood-label sum equals the total weight outside \(X_i\); positivity outside makes the condition automatic for \(N-n_i\ge2\) and forces the unique outside label to be \(2\) for \(N-n_i=1\). The displayed polynomial is therefore a disjoint exhaustive count. Direct exhaustive testing covers 87 multipartite types and 748341 ternary labelings through order nine.
